canonical_project: Telecentras VDC3 (state data center, Sausio 13-osios g.)
owner: Telecentras (AB Lietuvos radijo ir televizijos centras); builders Agentus + KV Baltic
notes: One of two new state DCs (with VDC4, ~300 racks combined) officially opened late Sept 2024; >EUR 20M combined investment. Completion act initially rejected 2024-09-24 (documentation gaps); Tier III certificate granted by Uptime Institute by Apr 2025; in testing/commissioning as of late 2024. VDC3 sits near TV tower (Sausio 13-osios g. area).
